title: Enterprise Mining, Autonomous Haulage (AHS), Geometallurgical Ore Blending, SAG Mill MPC & Tailings InSAR Safety Agent

tiers.tier: Tier 1: Fixed Truck-Shovel Locking + Single-Loop SAG Mill PID + Monthly Manual Tailings Walk
tiers.architecture: Static shovel-to-crusher haulage assignment + fixed tonnage SAG feed PID + manual monthly piezometer clipboard readings

tiers.tier: Tier 2: Prompt-Only General LLM Mine Dispatch & Mill Log Chatbot
tiers.architecture: Feeding raw shift-dispatch radio logs and SCADA alarms into an LLM to adjust SAG mill water/feed and haul truck routes

tiers.tier: Tier 3: Siloed GPS Fleet Dispatch + Uncoupled Mill Regression ML
tiers.architecture: Shortest-path truck dispatch without ore-hardness/clay blending constraints + isolated mill power ML without upstream fragmentation feed-forward

tiers.tier: Tier 4: Geometallurgical Blending AHS MILP + 3D Fragmentation Feed-Forward SAG MPC + GISTM InSAR/VWP Tailings Agent
tiers.architecture: Shovel XRF/3D-Fragmentation VLM + Short-Term Ore-Blending Haulage MILP + Acoustic/Bearing-Pressure SAG Mill MPC + GISTM InSAR & Piezometer Safety Interlock Agent

scenarios.scenario: Geometallurgical Ore-Hardness (Bond Work Index BWi) & Deleterious Clay Blending Haulage MILP
scenarios.question: Shovel #4 enters a high-clay (>12% smectite), high-arsenic pocket while Shovel #2 digs hard quartz-porphyry ore (BWi = 21.5 kWh/t); dispatch 140 300-tonne AHS trucks
scenarios.model_answer: Solve rolling-horizon truck-shovel blending MILP to cap crusher feed smectite clay <= 4.5%, arsenic <= 800 ppm, and smooth BWi hardness variance while minimizing crusher queue wait (1.8% idle waste)
scenarios.tier1_3_failure: Tier 3 shortest-path dispatch dumps 6 consecutive high-clay loads into the primary crusher, blinding screens and choking flotation recovery (-14.8% loss).

scenarios.scenario: SAG Mill Acoustic Toe-Angle + Trunnion Bearing-Pressure MPC to Prevent 'Mill Belly-Out' Overload
scenarios.question: 3D laser belt VLM detects coarse blast fragmentation (F80 spikes from 95mm to 165mm) entering SAG Mill #1; prevent volumetric overload
scenarios.model_answer: Feed-forward F80 particle size into multivariable SAG Mill MPC; fuse shell acoustic microphone toe-angle with trunnion hydrostatic bearing pressure to proactively trim fresh feed by 8% and adjust Variable Speed Drive (VSD) RPM (0.3 stalls/mo)
scenarios.tier1_3_failure: Tier 1 fixed-tonnage PID keeps pumping 4,200 t/h of coarse rock until the SAG mill 'bellies out' (charge volume > 36%), forcing a 6-hour grind-out shutdown.

scenarios.scenario: Froth Flotation Bubble-Size Velocity VLM & Xanthate Collector Reagent Dosing
scenarios.question: Camera over Rougher Flotation Cell #3 observes sluggish, coalescing large bubbles and dark mineral-barren froth
scenarios.model_answer: Froth VLM extracts bubble size distribution (D50), collapse rate, and velocity vectors; MPC increments frother (MIBC) by +4 g/t and adjusts air-sparging + pulp level (+2.8% Cu/Au recovery)
scenarios.tier1_3_failure: Tier 1 waits 4 hours for shift fire-assay lab results while $42,000 of copper sulfide reports directly to tailings.

scenarios.scenario: GISTM Tailings Storage Facility (TSF) Satellite InSAR + Vibrating-Wire Piezometer (VWP) Pore-Pressure Interlock
scenarios.question: After 90mm of heavy rainfall, Beach Sector C Vibrating-Wire Piezometers show pore-water pressure ratio B-bar rising to 0.44 alongside +3.8 mm/week InSAR crest deformation
scenarios.model_answer: Trigger GISTM TARP Level-3 interlock: immediately halt spigotting/deposition on Sector C, divert tailings slurry to Emergency Cell B, open relief decant pumps, and page Engineer-of-Record (0.0% alarm escape)
scenarios.tier1_3_failure: Tier 1 monthly manual walk misses the rapid pore-pressure buildup between inspections (3.8% escape rate).

perturbation_checks.check: Heavy Dust & Steam Obscuration on Primary Crusher 3D Fragmentation Laser / Camera
perturbation_checks.perturbed: 0.4 Mill/Haulage Stalls/Mo | 1.4% Loss (Fallback to Crusher Mantle Current + Shovel Dipper Dig-Energy Estimator)

perturbation_checks.check: GISTM Tailings Pore-Water Pressure (B-bar >= 0.40) Hard Spigot Shutoff Gate
perturbation_checks.perturbed: 0.0% Escape (Hardware PLC Interlock Blocks Slurry Deposition Regardless of Mill Throughput Target)

key_findings: Tier 4 (Geometallurgical Ore-Blending AHS MILP + 3D Fragmentation Feed-Forward SAG Mill MPC + Froth Flotation VLM + GISTM InSAR/VWP Tailings Interlock) cuts SAG mill overload stalls and haulage bottlenecks from 16.4/month to 0.3/month (-98.2%).
Replacing shortest-path truck dispatch with a rolling-horizon geometallurgical blending MILP caps deleterious clay/arsenic spikes and cuts truck queue / shovel starvation waste from 23.6% to 1.8%.

Coupling belt 3D fragmentation VLM with acoustic/bearing-pressure SAG mill MPC and frothy bubble-velocity VLM reduces grinding energy and recovery losses from 14.8% to 1.2%, cutting monthly mine-to-mill TCO from $1.42M to $135K (-90.5%) with 0.0% tailings alarm escape.
